page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a short italic note set in the right margin beside the lower paragraph, with a signature line "Theod: de la Guard." at its right; a catchword-like signature "J" at the bottom right corner. Running head at top centre; page number at top left.

main_text.l: beene long carbonadoed, des veniam verbo, in flames
of affection towards you. Your Majesty know or
may know, time was, when J did, or would have
done you a better peece of service, than all your
Troopes and Regiments are now doing. Should J
heare any Gentleman that follow you, of my yeares,
say he loves you better than J, if it were lawfull, J
would sweare by my sword, he said more than his
sword would make good.
Gracious Sir, Vouchsafe to pardon mee my no
other sinne, but my long Idolatry towards you, and J
will pardon you your treason against me, even me, by
committing treason against your Selfe my Lord and
King; and your murther in murthering me, even me,
by murthering my dear fellow-Subjects, bone of my
bone, and flesh of my flesh, and of yours also. If
you will not pardon me, J will pardon my self, dwell
in my owne cloaths as long as J can, and make as
good a shift fo my proportion, as he that hath a ligh-
ter paire of heels : And when you have done what
you please and what you can, J am resolved to be

marginalia.note: As loyall a Subject to your Majesty when I have never a head on my shoulders, as you a Royall King to me, when you have your three Crownes on your head.

page.notes: The right-margin italic text is a verse-like couplet set as a note; the lower-right "Theod: de la Guard." is a signature. Faint show-through from the reverse page appears in the lower half and is omitted. The "J" at bottom right is a signature mark.
